original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚阿布贾一名保安因涉嫌盗窃汽车配件出庭受审
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚阿布贾Life Camp地方法院周三开庭审理一名保安Ishaya Alkali，其被指控涉嫌盗窃价值1000万奈拉的20件进口汽车配件。被告否认指控，获准以50万奈拉保释，案件延期至11月4日审理。该报道来自单一来源。

location.raw_text: Life Camp Magistrates’ Court in Abuja

key_facts.fact: 保安Ishaya Alkali因涉嫌盗窃20件进口汽车配件在阿布贾Life Camp地方法院出庭
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A security guard, Ishaya Alkali, was on Wednesday docked in a Life Camp Magistrates’ Court in Abuja for allegedly 20 pieces of imported car spare parts worth N10 million.
20 pieces of imported car spare parts worth N10 million

key_facts.fact: 被告否认指控，获准以50万奈拉保释
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He pleaded not guilty to the charge. ... Magistrate Ramlatu Yusuf, admitted the defendant to bail in the sum N500,000 with one surety in like sum.
She adjourned the matter until Nov 4 for hearing.

uncertainties: 盗窃指控尚未经法院判决证实，被告已否认指控
报道为单一来源，尚未获得交叉验证
